records.original_stem:
The pharmacist is checking partial-fill records. The option states the reason for the partial fill; a shortage is not retroactively reclassified as a patient request. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

A.original_option_text: A pharmacist counts each partial fill as a new full quantity authorization.
A.finding_ko: 틀린 처리 — partial fills의 총량은 total quantity prescribed를 넘을 수 없다. 부분교부마다 새 fullquantity authorization이 생기지 않는다.

B.original_option_text: An unrelated adult with no qualifying authority substitutes a purported partial-fill request for the minor patient’s parent or guardian.
B.finding_ko: 틀린 처리 — patient 본인, minor의 parent/legal guardian, 조문상 medicalPOA에 이름이 있는 adultcaregiver,원prescriber 등 적격요청자와 무관계성인을 구별한다. 권한없는성인은 minor의parent/guardian을 대체못한다.

C.original_option_text: For an emergency oral CII requested partial, the pharmacist applies the non-emergency 30-day remainder limit.
C.finding_ko: 틀린 처리 — emergency oralCII의 requestedpartial remainder는 prescription issue후72시간이다. 일반requestedwritten/EPCS의30일을 적용하지 않는다.

D.original_option_text: A Massachusetts pharmacy completes a qualifying patient-requested CII remainder at the same pharmacy that supplied the initial partial.
D.finding_ko: 옳은 처리 — MA 조항은 최초 lesserquantity를 dispense한 pharmacy만 remainingportion을 dispense하도록 한다. 다른조건이충족된samepharmacy completion은맞다.

records.case_application_ko: 각 선택지는 별도 기록이며 명시된 다른 prerequisites 가정을 유지했다. 키가 가리킨 처리 D는 해당 공식 조항으로 지지된다.
records.original_explanation_assessment_ko: 원 한국어 해설의 각 선택지별 법적 구분은 해당 공식 근거에 부합한다. 같은 명제의 반복은 중복·현실성 추가 검토 신호로 남기되 반복만으로 법률 실패 처리하지 않았다.
records.blocker: 독립 legal/realism 감사 미실시. KEEP는 작성자 단계 판단이며 release 인증이 아니다.

records.original_stem:
A Massachusetts pharmacist reviews outpatient labels and proposed substitutions. Assume the prescriber’s intended ingredient, strength, dosage form, and route are known. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

A.original_option_text: A pharmacist uses the relevant FDA Purple Book information when evaluating biological interchangeability.

B.original_option_text: A pharmacy treats the statutory ten-characters-per-inch wording as an automatic requirement for ten-point type.

C.original_option_text: A pharmacist gives a reconstituted medication a one-year label date without considering its shorter in-use limit.

D.original_option_text: A pharmacist labels only the originally prescribed brand when a different interchangeable product is actually dispensed.
